metadata.title: Combs and complex structures on the six-sphere
metadata.abstract: We construct complex structures on the six-sphere $S^6$ with arbitrarily large local Kuranishi dimension. As a corollary, we find the same phenomenon holds for the smooth manifold underlying complex projective 3-space $\mathbb{P}^3$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: S⁶ complex structure 的构造宣称
analysis.workSummary: 作者宣称在 S⁶ 上构造具有任意大 local Kuranishi dimension 的 complex structure，并为 smooth CP³ 给对应构造。
analysis.breakthrough: 若 integrability 与全局构造成立，将解决长期开放的 S⁶ complex structure 问题。
analysis.limitations: 必须核对全局 integrability、过渡映射与底层 smooth manifold 的识别；作者宣称不能当作已获独立验证的定论。
analysis.priorityReason: 若 integrability 与全局构造成立，将解决长期开放的 S⁶ complex structure 问题。
